closure.requirementText: - **DAT-07:** Verify missing, zero and invalid values retain distinct semantics; do not treat missing data as zero unless the application explicitly requires it.
closure.review: Reviewed complete DAT-07 wording against the supported public visualization workflow. Input tags preserve finite zero, null, undefined, NaN and both infinities; independent expected counts/category order guard JSON conflation. Exact zero query and actual emitted tooltip text, a painted segment through zero, absent queries across all missing/invalid positions, absent bridging pixels, and valid post-gap interpolation establish distinct semantics. Generation-bound replacement removes old metadata. Native Studio replay exercises the same application via pointer input; measured float32 transport precision is explicit and cannot be mistaken for missing-as-zero. This establishes the declared application policy, not automatic inference of arbitrary business coercion or unobscured glyph visibility. No production API or broader data/visualization requirement is certified by this closure. Prior artifacts retain their original dated scope. Existing stale layout-test and signal-graph fingerprints were also revalidated against their relevant current behavior suites; no runtime semantics were changed to reconcile these records.

closure.requirementText: - **APP-11:** Record loading/error/retry and asynchronous response ordering for application data; stale responses must follow the application's declared policy.
closure.review: Reviewed the complete APP-11 wording against the application-owned hover fixture and retained execution. Loading, error, retry, response ordering and declared stale-response policy are observable and independently asserted. Current failure retains chart data; retry clears error and commits a new generation; stale success/error cannot overwrite current data or request status. Queued responses are revoked on reset/disposal and cannot affect remounts. This closes APP-11 for the supported reference application workflow, not generic network interception, all possible application policies, or unrelated application requirements. The normal browser configuration passed; the separate material-lab catalog validation failure is not evidence about this workflow. Mixed-validity visualization mode was added on 2026-10-01. Re-reviewed the affected shared lab/catalog against twenty-six focused browser tests and a fresh native replay of this completed workflow; only the reviewed shared-file fingerprints were refreshed. Extended native replay reviewed after appending mixed-validity checks: existing async actions and expectations are unchanged and all pass. Only replay/required-check declaration fingerprints refreshed using the retained 127-check run.

acceptance.criterion: Record loading/error/retry separately from rendered chart generation and retain data on failure.
Record asynchronous completion ordering and obey declared latest-request-wins policy for both stale success and stale error.
Revoke queued responses on reset/disposal, preserve historical snapshots, and isolate subsequent mounts.
